propositions: The planning corpus size assertion (113) drifts against live ticket state because membership is re-derived at runtime from current ticket classifications rather than pinned to a fixed commit set.
Reclassifying any historical ticket to/from bug type or adding tickets that change short-prefix resolution causes the corpus count to diverge from the hardcoded constant.
The solution is to pin the corpus by commit identity (frozenset of 113 SHAs from the historical analysis point) rather than by count, making the check immune to tracker churn.
In check mode, iterate the pinned SHAs directly and validate the measured set's identity matches the pin and flagged set equals ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE exactly.
The corpus is pinned and reproducible by identity; per-row ticket labels remain best-effort metadata for artifacts only and no longer gate the check.
